items.title: "It creates lesser games": Indie game studios are supposed to love generative AI, so why do the 25 devs I spoke to avoid it?
items.excerpt: GamesRadar interviewed 25 indie developers about why they steer clear of generative AI despite promises of faster production, finding most feel it yields lower-quality work for often higher cost. A craft-and-workflow snapshot of how gen AI is actually landing in small-studio design pipelines.

items.title: Steam study of over 53,000 games finds "60-90% of the growth" in monthly releases is from games using AI, and "almost none of them make money"
items.excerpt: A study of 53,000+ Steam titles finds AI-flagged games now drive 60-90% of the growth in monthly releases, even as nearly none find commercial success. A data-driven look at how generative AI is reshaping what independent creators actually ship.

items.title: Steam Week in Review: more than half of new Steam games will have an AI disclosure by 2027-2028
items.excerpt: Tracking Steam's AI-disclosure data, PC Gamer projects that AI-flagged games cross the 50% mark of all releases between 2027 and 2028, with roughly one in three new games already disclosing generative-AI content. Signals how mainstream AI-assisted game-making is becoming.

items.title: Houdini 22 Is Out Now, Bringing Native Gaussian Splats, New UI, and More
items.excerpt: SideFX shipped Houdini 22 with native Gaussian Splats (neural radiance-field capture), a redesigned UI, Copernicus and KineFX upgrades, and new rendering workflows for game and VFX production. Brings AI-adjacent neural-capture tooling into a core game-art content pipeline.
